To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cellular antioxidant capacity determines the sensitivity of cells to oxidative DNA damage and to oxidant induction of growth-related genes.

the cellular antioxidant defense system is a complex network of interacting enzymes and that the balance between these antioxidant enzymes rather than their absolute activities determines the degree of cellular protection against oxidative stress.

the cellular antioxidant capacity is an important determinant of oxidant carcinogenesis, that the balance of several antioxidant enzymes determines the degree of antioxidant protection, and that the cellular antioxidant system is a critical factor in the regulation of oxidant-induced signal transduction pathways.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the cellular defense system in the prevention of carcinogenic damage by oxidant chemicals and light.
the elucidation of the molecular mechanisms by which oxidants cause genetic damage and induce the expression of protooncogenes and growth-related genes.
the cellular defense against reactive oxygen species (ROS), and the role of ROS in the induction of cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cellular antioxidant defense is a complex system that is not easily manipulated by genetic means.
the cellular antioxidant defense is a key component in the cellular response to oxidative damage, including that caused by carcinogenic oxidants.
the balance of antioxidant enzymes in the cells determines the degree of cellular protection.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the balance between the activities of several antioxidant enzymes rather that the activity of a singe component determines the degree to which cells are protected against oxidant-induced DNA damage.
a balanced cellular antioxidant system is required for protection against the action of oxidant carcinogens.
the balance between the antioxidant enzymes SOD, CAT, and GPx rather than the activity levels of any single component determines the cellular antioxidant defense.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cellular antioxidant capacity affects oxidant carcinogenesis in a complex manner.
the antioxidant enzymes are interrelated in their function, and their balance is important for the cellular antioxidant defense.
the cellular antioxidant defense system plays a critical role in determining the sensitivity of cells to oxidative damage and to the carcinogenic action induced by oxidants.
